mapper.sql: select h.adjustment_hist_id as "adjustmentHistId", h.target_user_id as "targetUserId", case when k.name is not null then k.name else u.login_id end as "targetUserName", h.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", h.area_code as "areaCode", h.management_item_code as "managementItemCode", h.adjustment_target as "adjustmentTarget", h.before_value as "beforeValue", h.after_value as "afterValue", h.adjustment_reason as "adjustmentReason", case when adj_k.name is not null then adj_k.name else adjusted_user.login_id end as "adjustedByName", case when appr_k.name is not null then appr_k.name else approved_user.login_id end as "approvedByName", h.adjusted_at as "adjustedAt", h.request_id as "requestId" from biz_score_adj_hist h join users u on u.user_id = h.target_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots k on k.employee_no = u.employee_no left join users adjusted_user on adjusted_user.user_id = h.adjusted_by left join korus_personnel_snapshots adj_k on adj_k.employee_no = adjusted_user.employee_no left join users approved_user on approved_user.user_id = h.approved_by left join korus_personnel_snapshots appr_k on appr_k.employee_no = approved_user.employee_no
mapper.select: order by h.evaluation_year desc, h.adjusted_at desc, h.adjustment_hist_id limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}
mapper.insert: insert into business_process_audit_logs (action_type, target_key, before_state, after_state, actor_user_id, result_status, request_id, created_at) values ('BATCH', #{targetKey}, null, cast(#{afterStateJson} as jsonb), #{actorUserId}, 'SUCCESS', #{requestId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
